facts.text: ArduinoPCR is the host-side serial controller class of the Cetus PCR
The application constructs the controller with baudrate 9600 and timeout 1
The Arduino firmware opens the serial port at 9600 baud
The firmware announces 'Cetus is ready.' after its setup
The firmware frames a command between '<' and '>' and splits its arguments on spaces
The command <peltier state pwm_signal> uses state 0 to heat and state 1 to cool
A heating command writes the heat PWM, clears the cool PWM and prints tempSample and tempLid
A cooling command writes the cool PWM and clears the heat PWM
The firmware ends every processed command with the line nextpls
The firmware handles only the peltier and printTemps commands; it has no temperature setpoint command
The controller sends <peltier 0 N> for heating and <peltier 1 N> for cooling, with N the integer PID output or its absolute value
The PID output is limited to -255 to 255
On cancellation the upstream loop writes <peltier 0 0> and returns
The experiment loop checks is_running only inside the is_waiting branch
serial_monitor sets is_waiting True when a nextpls line arrives
serial_monitor parses tempSample and tempLid lines into current_sample_temperature and current_lid_temperature
run_experiment repeats the experiment steps n_cycles times
initialize_connection scans the serial ports, opens the matching port and checks the startup line before starting serial_monitor
The upstream close path clears is_running, clears is_connected and closes the serial device

operator_required.name: run_protocol
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a maximum cycle count: the upstream loop is range(int(n_cycles)) with no bound (functions.py:123). The site supplies the number of cycles it allows

operator_required.name: run_protocol
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a maximum hold time: the upstream loop runs until the step duration the operator entered (functions.py:131-170). The site supplies the longest hold it allows

operator_required.name: run_protocol
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a safe sample temperature range for the machine: the firmware drives the Peltier directly by PWM and has no temperature setpoint command (arduino/cetuspcr/serialtools.h:81-107); the PCR phase temperatures in the report are protocol examples, not limits of this device. The site supplies the range of its machine

safe_state.description: Peltier drives at zero PWM (is_running cleared and <peltier 0 0> written; the firmware also clears the cooling PWM)
